```cpp
    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t");
    return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
```

        if len(fields) != num_columns:

            print("ValueError")

            return

        try:

            # Parse each field as float

            parsed = []

            for field in fields:

                stripped = field.strip()

                if not stripped:

                    return

                parsed_field = float(stripped)

                parsed.append(parsed_field)

            parsed_data.append(parsed)

        col_idx = header.index(col)

        current_sum = 0.0

        sums = []

        for val in column_values:

            current_sum += val

            sums.append(current_sum)

        cumulative_sums[col] = sums

    # Now compute scaled values for each row

    output_rows = []

    for row_idx in range(len(parsed_data)):

            s = sums[row_idx]

            max_s = max(sums)

            if min_s == max_s:

            else:

        formatted = ['%.6f' % round(val,6) for val in scaled_row]

        output_rows.append(','.join(formatted))

    # Output

    print(','.join(header))

    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t");
    return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);

                token.clear();

}

string trim(const string &s) {

    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t\n\r");

vector<string> split_into_sentences(const string &input) {
    vector<string> sentences;
    size_t pos = 0;
    size_t next_dot = input.find('.', pos);
    while (next_dot != string::npos) {
        string part = input.substr(pos, next_dot - pos);
        string trimmed = trim(part);
        if (!trimmed.empty()) {
            sentences.push_back(trimmed);
        }
        pos = next_dot + 1;
        next_dot = input.find('.', pos);
    }
    // Add the remaining part after last dot
    string part = input.substr(pos);
    string trimmed = trim(part);
    if (!trimmed.empty()) {
        sentences.push_back(trimmed);
    }
    return sentences;
}

```cpp
using namespace std;

string trim(const string& s) {
    size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(" \t\n\r");
    if (start == string::npos) return "";
    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t\n\r");
    return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
}

vector<string> split_on_delimiter(const string& s, char delimiter) {
    vector<string> parts;
    size_t pos = 0;
    size_t next;
    while ((next = s.find(delimiter, pos)) != string::npos) {
        parts.push_back(s.substr(pos, next - pos));
        pos = next + 1;
    }
    parts.push_back(s.substr(pos));
    return parts;
}

void tokenize_sentence(const string& sentence, unordered_map<string, int>& counts, set<string>& global_words) {
    string lower_sentence;
    for (char c : sentence) lower_sentence += tolower(c);

    vector<string> words;
    string current;
    for (char c : lower_sentence) {
        if (isalnum(c)) {
            current += c;
            if (current.size() >= 2) {
                words.push_back(current);
                current.clear();
            }
        } else {
            if (!current.empty() && current.size() >= 2) {
                words.push_back(current);
                current.clear();
            }
        }
    }
    if (!current.empty() && current.size() >= 2) {
        words.push_back(current);
    }

    for (const string& word : words) {
        global_words.insert(word);
        counts[word]++;
    }
}

vector<unordered_map<string, int>> process_text(const string& input, set<string>& global_words) {

        unordered_map<string, int> counts;
        tokenize_sentence(sentences[i], counts, global_words);
        sentence_counts.push_back(counts);
    }
    return sentence_counts;
}
```

```python
import sys
import scipy.stats as stats

def main():
    lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin if line.strip()]
    if not lines:
        print("ValueError")
        return

    initial = lines[0].split(',')
    col1, col2 = initial[0], initial[1]

    csv_header_line = lines[1] if len(lines) >= 2 else ''
    csv_header = csv_header_line.split(',') if csv_header_line else []
    data_rows = lines[2:] if len(lines) >= 2 else []

    if not data_rows:
        print("ValueError")
        return

    if col1 not in csv_header or col2 not in csv_header:
        print("ValueError")
        return

    idx_col1 = csv_header.index(col1)
    idx_col2 = csv_header.index(col2)

    col1_vals = []
    col2_vals = []
    for row in data_rows:
        vals = row.split(',')
        col1_vals.append(vals[idx_col1])
        col2_vals.append(vals[idx_col2])

    def is_numeric(values):
        for v in values:
            try:
                float(v)
            except ValueError:
                return False
        return True

    if is_numeric(col1_vals) or is_numeric(col2_vals):
        print("TypeError")
        return

    unique1 = len(set(col1_vals))
    unique2 = len(set(col2_vals))
    if unique1 < 2 or unique2 < 2:
        print("ValueError")
        return

    contingency = {}
    for row in data_rows:
        vals = row.split(',')
        key = (vals[idx_col1], vals[idx_col2])
        contingency[key] = contingency.get(key, 0) + 1

    for count in contingency.values():
        if count < 5:
            print("ValueError")
            return

    row_sums = {}
    col_sums = {}
    total = len(data_rows)
    for v in set(col1_vals):
        row_sums[v] = sum(1 for row in data_rows if row.split(',')[idx_col1] == v)
    for v in set(col2_vals):
        col_sums[v] = sum(1 for row in data_rows if row.split(',')[idx_col2] == v)

    df = (len(set(col1_vals)) - 1) * (len(set(col2_vals)) - 1)
    chi2_stat = 0.0
    for (c1, c2), count in contingency.items():
        row = row_sums.get(c1, 0)
        col = col_sums.get(c2, 0)
        expected = (row * col) / total
        chi2_stat += (count - expected) ** 2 / expected

    p_value = stats.chi2.cdf(chi2_stat, df)
    print(f"{p_value:.6f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

To solve this problem, we need to read tabular data from standard input, normalize selected columns using min-max normalization, and output the result as a JSON object. The normalization process involves adjusting the values of specified columns so that the smallest value becomes 0, the largest becomes 1, and all other values are linearly interpolated between these two extremes. If all values in a column are identical, all normalized values should be 0.

### Approach
1. **Read Input**: Parse the input data into a JSON object for columns and a JSON array of column names to normalize.
2. **Column Order Preservation**: Ensure the output maintains the same column order as the input.
3. **Normalization Process**:
   - For each specified column, compute the minimum and maximum values.
   - If all values are the same, set normalized values to 0.0.
   - Otherwise, apply the min-max normalization formula and round results to 4 decimal places.
4. **Output Preparation**: Construct the result JSON object with normalized or unchanged values, ensuring the correct column order.

### Solution Code
```python
import json
import sys

def main():
    # Read the first line which is the columns data in JSON format
    first_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    columns_json = json.loads(first_line)
    
    # Read the second line which is the list of columns to normalize
    second_line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    normalize_list = json.loads(second_line)
    
    # Preserve the order of columns as they appear in the first JSON object
    column_order = list(columns_json.keys())
    
    result = {}
    
    def normalize_column(values):
        min_val = min(values)
        max_val = max(values)
        if min_val == max_val:
            return [0.0 for _ in values]
        else:
            range_val = max_val - min_val
            normalized = []
            for v in values:
                normalized_val = (v - min_val) / range_val
                normalized.append(round(normalized_val, 4))
            return normalized
    
    for col_name in column_order:
        col_data = columns_json[col_name]
        if col_name in normalize_list:
            normalized_data = normalize_column(col_data)
            result[col_name] = normalized_data
        else:
            result[col_name] = col_data  # No change for non-normalized columns
    
    # Output the result as JSON, preserving order
    print(json.dumps(result, separators=(',', ':')))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

### Explanation
1. **Reading Input**: The input is read in two lines. The first line is parsed into a dictionary where keys are column names and values are lists of numbers. The second line is parsed into a list of column names to normalize.
2. **Column Order**: The order of columns from the first JSON object is preserved using `dict.keys()`, which maintains insertion order in Python 3.7+.
3. **Normalization Function**: 
   - For each column to normalize, compute min and max values.
   - If all values are the same, return a list of zeros.
   - Otherwise, apply the normalization formula and round to 4 decimal places.
4. **Result Construction**: The result dictionary is built by iterating over columns in their original order, applying normalization where specified, and leaving others unchanged.
5. **Output**: The final result is printed as a JSON object, ensuring the same column order and rounded values as required.

To solve this problem, we need to process a JSON array of objects and generate a summary of distinct values for each of the keys "x", "y", and "z". The summary should include the count of each value's occurrences, ordered by descending count and earliest first occurrence if counts are equal.

### Approach
1. **Parse Input**: Read and parse the input JSON data into a list of dictionaries.
2. **Process Each Key**: For each key ("x", "y", "z"), collect values from records that contain the key.
3. **Tally Values**: Track the count of each value and the first occurrence index of each value.
4. **Sort Values**: Sort the values based on their counts in descending order. If counts are equal, sort by the first occurrence index in ascending order.
5. **Construct Output**: Create the required JSON object with sorted value-count pairs for each key.

```python
import json
import sys

def process_key(key, records):
    tally = {}
    first_occurrence = {}
    for idx, record in enumerate(records):
        if key in record:
            value = record[key]
            if value not in tally:
                tally[value] = 1
                first_occurrence[value] = idx
            else:
                tally[value] += 1
    # Prepare the list of [value, count] pairs sorted as required
    items = [(val, count) for val, count in tally.items()]
    # Sort by descending count, then ascending first occurrence
    items.sort(key=lambda x: (-x[1], first_occurrence[x[0]]))
    return [[v, c] for v, c in items]

def main():
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    result = {}
    for key in ['x', 'y', 'z']:
        result[key] = process_key(key, data)
    print(json.dumps(result, separators=(',', ':'), sort_keys=True))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
import sys

def pearson_correlation(x, y):
    n = len(x)
    if n == 0:
        return 0.0
    x_mean = sum(x) / n
    y_mean = sum(y) / n
    numerator = 0.0
    sum_x_sq = 0.0
    sum_y_sq = 0.0
    for a, b in zip(x, y):
        dx = a - x_mean
        dy = b - y_mean
        numerator += dx * dy
        sum_x_sq += dx ** 2
        sum_y_sq += dy ** 2
    if sum_x_sq == 0 or sum_y_sq == 0:
        return 0.0
    denominator = (sum_x_sq ** 0.5) * (sum_y_sq ** 0.5)
    r = numerator / denominator
    return abs(r)

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    if not input:
        return
    n_rows, n_cols = map(int, input[0].split())
    columns = input[1].split()
    data = []
    for i in range(2, 2 + n_rows):
        data.append(list(map(float, input[i].split())))
    try:
        percentage = float(input[-1])
    except:
        print("Error: Percentage must be between 0 and 1")
        return
    if percentage < 0 or percentage > 1:
        print("Error: Percentage must be between 0 and 1")
        return
    for i in range(n_cols):
        for j in range(i + 1, n_cols):
            x = [row[i] for row in data]
            y = [row[j] for row in data]
            corr = pearson_correlation(x, y)
            if corr > percentage:
                print(f"{columns[i]} {columns[j]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
            mean_b = sum(b) / n

            a_dev = [x - mean_a for x in a]
            b_dev = [y - mean_b for y in b]

            sum_ab = 0.0
            sum_a_sq = 0.0
            sum_b_sq = 0.0

            for x, y in zip(a_dev, b_dev):

                sum_a_sq += x ** 2

            if sum_a_sq == 0 or sum_b_sq == 0:

            else:

                abs_r = abs(sum_ab / denominator)
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

double compute_pearson(const vector<double>& x, const vector<double>& y) {
    int n = x.size();
    if (n != y.size()) return 0.0;

    double sum_x = 0.0, sum_y = 0.0;
    for (double val : x) sum_x += val;
    for (double val : y) sum_y += val;
    double mean_x = sum_x / n;
    double mean_y = sum_y / n;

    double sum_xy = 0.0, sum_x_sq = 0.0, sum_y_sq = 0.0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double xi = x[i] - mean_x;
        double yi = y[i] - mean_y;
        sum_xy += xi * yi;
        sum_x_sq += xi * xi;
        sum_y_sq += yi * yi;
    }

    if (sum_x_sq == 0.0 || sum_y_sq == 0.0) {
        return 0.0;
    }

    double denominator = sqrt(sum_x_sq) * sqrt(sum_y_sq);
    return sum_xy / denominator;
}

int main() {
    int n_rows, n_cols;
    cin >> n_rows >> n_cols;

    vector<string> columns(n_cols);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_cols; ++i) {
        cin >> columns[i];
    }

    vector<vector<double>> data_columns(n_cols, vector<double>(n_rows));
    for (int i = 0; i < n_rows; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n_cols; ++j) {
            double val;
            cin >> val;
            data_columns[j][i] = val;
        }
    }

    double percentage;
    cin >> percentage;

    if (percentage < 0.0 || percentage > 1.0) {
        cout << "Error: Percentage must be between 0 and 1" << endl;
        return 1;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n_cols; ++i) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n_cols; ++j) {
            double r = compute_pearson(data_columns[i], data_columns[j]);
            if (abs(r) > percentage) {
                cout << columns[i] << " " << columns[j] << endl;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <numeric>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    
    if (N < 2) {
        cout << "nan" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    vector<double> scores;
    vector<string> grades;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        string score_str, grade_str;
        cin >> score_str >> grade_str;
        scores.push_back(stod(score_str));
        grades.push_back(grade_str);
    }
    
    unordered_set<string> unique_grades(grades.begin(), grades.end());
    vector<string> sorted_grades(unique_grads.begin(), unique_grades.end());
    sort(sorted_grades.begin(), sorted_grades.end());
    
    unordered_map<string, int> grade_to_code;
    for (int i = 0; i < sorted_grades.size(); ++i) {
        grade_to_code[sorted_grades[i]] = i;
    }
    
    vector<int> encoded_grades;
    for (const string& grade : grades) {
        encoded_grades.push_back(grade_to_code[grade]);
    }
    
    double sum_x = accumulate(scores.begin(), scores.end(), 0.0);
    double x_mean = sum_x / N;
    
    double sum_y = accumulate(encoded_grades.begin(), encoded_grades.end(), 0);
    double y_mean = sum_y / N;
    
    double sum_xy = 0.0, sum_x_sq = 0.0, sum_y_sq = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        double dx = scores[i] - x_mean;
        double dy = encoded_grades[i] - y_mean;
        sum_xy += dx * dy;
        sum_x_sq += dx * dx;
        sum_y_sq += dy * dy;
    }
    
    double denominator = sqrt(sum_x_sq * sum_y_sq);
    double r;
    if (denominator == 0) {
        r = 0.0;
    } else {
        r = sum_xy / denominator;
    }
    
    r = round(r * 10000) / 10000;
    
    cout << fixed << setprecision(4) << r << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
```

        size_t pos = 0;

```cpp
    } catch (const invalid_argument&) {

    } catch (const out_of_range&) {
```

```python
import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    rows = []
    for _ in range(n):
        line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        parts = line.split(',')
        id_ = int(parts[0])
        age = float(parts[1])
        income = float(parts[2])
        rows.append((id_, age, income))
    
    # Group ages and incomes by id
    groups = defaultdict(lambda: {'ages': [], 'incomes': []})
    for row in rows:
        id_, age, income = row
        groups[id_]['ages'].append(age)
        groups[id_]['incomes'].append(income)
    
    scaled_rows = []
    for row in rows:
        id_, age, income = row
        scaled = {'age': 0.0, 'income': 0.0}
        g = groups[id_]
        ages = g['ages']
        incomes = g['incomes']
        
        # Process age
        min_a = min(ages)
        max_a = max(ages)
        if min_a != max_a:
            scaled_age = (age - min_a) / (max_a - min_a)
        else:
            scaled_age = 0.0
        
        # Process income
        min_i = min(incomes)
        max_i = max(incomes)
        if min_i != max_i:
            scaled_income = (income - min_i) / (max_i - min_i)
        else:
            scaled_income = 0.0
        
        scaled['age'] = scaled_age
        scaled['income'] = scaled_income
        scaled_rows.append(scaled)
    
    # Collect all scaled incomes for histogram
    all_scaled_income = [row['income'] for row in scaled_rows]
    min_inc = min(all_scaled_income) if all_scaled_income else 0.0
    max_inc = max(all_scaled_income) if all_scaled_income else 0.0
    
    # Prepare edges for histogram
    if min_inc == max_inc:
        edge_values = [round(min_inc, 6)] * 11
    else:
        width = (max_inc - min_inc) / 10.0
        edges = []
        current = min_inc
        for i in range(11):
            edges.append(current + i * width)
            current += width
        edge_values = [round(e, 6) for e in edges]
    
    # Calculate bin counts
    bin_counts = [0] * 10
    if min_inc != max_inc:
        for income in all_scaled_income:
            delta = (income - min_inc) / (max_inc - min_inc)
            bin_idx = int(delta * 10)
            if bin_idx >= 10:
                bin_idx = 9
            elif bin_idx < 0:
                bin_idx = 0
            bin_counts[bin_idx] += 1
    
    # Output
    print(n)
    for scaled in scaled_rows:

        inc_sc = scaled['income']
        print(f"{scaled['id']} {age_sc:.6f} {inc_sc:.6f}")
    print("HIST")
    print(' '.join(map(str, bin_counts)))
    print(' '.join(map(lambda x: f"{x:.6f}", edge_values)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <iomanip>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    if (N == 0) return 0;

    vector<vector<string>> records;
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        istringstream iss(line);
        string label, token;
        vector<string> fields;
        iss >> label;
        while (iss >> token) {
            fields.push_back(token);
        }
        records.push_back(fields);
    }

    int M = 0;
    for (const auto& fields : records) {
        if (fields.size() > M) {
            M = fields.size();
        }
    }

    for (int p = 1; p <= M; ++p) {
        double sum = 0.0;
        int count = 0;
        for (const auto& fields : records) {
            if (fields.size() >= p) {
                string token = fields[p - 1];
                try {
                    double d = stod(token);
                    sum += d;
                    count++;
                } catch (...) {
                    // Token is not a number, ignore
                }
            }
        }
        if (count == 0) {
            cout << "Position " << p << ": nan\n";
        } else {
            double mean = sum / count;
            cout << "Position " << p << ": " << fixed << setprecision(1) << mean << '\n';
        }
    }

    return 0;
}
```

#include <iostream>

```cpp
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<double> sales(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> sales[i];
    }

    double sumx = 0, sumy = 0, sumxy = 0, sumx2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        sumx += i;
        sumy += sales[i];
        sumxy += i * sales[i];
        sumx2 += i * i;
    }

    double a, b;
    if (n == 1) {
        a = sales[0];
        b = 0.0;
    } else {
        double denominator = n * sumx2 - sumx * sumx;
        double numerator_b = n * sumxy - sumx * sumy;
        b = numerator_b / denominator;
        a = (sumy - b * sumx) / n;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double x = n + i;
        double y = a + b * x;
        y = round(y * 10000) / 10000;
        cout << fixed << setprecision(4) << y;
        if (i != n - 1) cout << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    return 0;
}
```

```python
import sys
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import zoneinfo

def main():
    target_tz_identifier = input().strip()
    try:
        target_tz = zoneinfo.ZoneInfo(target_tz_identifier)
    except zoneinfo.ZoneInfoNotFoundError:
        print("Invalid time format")
        return

    try:
        n = int(input().strip())
    except ValueError:
        print("Invalid time format")
        return

    if n == 0:
        return

    timestamp_pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<day>\d{2})/(?P<month>\d{2})/(?P<year>\d{2}) '
        r'(?P<hour>\d{2}):(?P<minute>\d{2}):(?P<second>\d{2})\.(?P<ms>\d{3})$'
    )

    for _ in range(n):
        timestamp = input().strip()
        match = timestamp_pattern.match(timestamp)
        if not match:
            print("Invalid time format")
            return

        day, month, year, hour, minute, second, ms = match.groups()
        day, month, year, hour, minute, second, ms = map(int, [day, month, year, hour, minute, second, ms])

        dt_naive = datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, microsecond=ms * 1000)
        dt_utc = dt_naive.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
        dt_target = dt_utc.astimezone(target_tz)

        print(f"{timestamp}, {dt_target.strftime('%d/%m/%y %H:%M:%S.%f')}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```cpp
string trim(const string &s) {
    size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(" \t\n\r");
    if (start == string::npos) return "";
    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t\n\r");
    return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
}

vector<string> split_comma(const string &s) {

    stringstream ss(s);
    string part;
    while (getline(ss, part, ',')) {
        part = trim(part);
        if (!part.empty()) parts.push_back(part);
    }
    return parts;
}
```

```cpp
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<double> x(n), y(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i];
    }

    double sumx = accumulate(x.begin(), x.end(), 0.0);
    double sumy = accumulate(y.begin(), y.end(), 0.0);
    double sumx2 = 0.0, sumxy = 0.0;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        sumx2 += x[i] * x[i];
        sumxy += x[i] * y[i];
    }

    bool all_same = true;
    double first_x = x[0];

        b = sumy / n;
    } else {
        double denominator = n * sumx2 - sumx * sumx;
        double numerator_a = n * sumxy - sumx * sumy;
        a = numerator_a / denominator;
        b = (sumy - a * sumx) / n;
    }

    cout << fixed << setprecision(4) << a << " " << b << endl;

    return 0;
}
```

#include <iostream>

#include <string>
#include <sstream>

```cpp
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;

    vector<string> columns(C);
    for (int i = 0; i < C; ++i) {
        cin >> columns[i];
    }

    vector<vector<string>> data(R);
    for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
        data[i].resize(C);
        for (int j = 0; j < C; ++j) {
            cin >> data[i][j];
        }
    }

    int K;
    cin >> K;
    unordered_set<string> standardize_set;
    if (K > 0) {
        vector<string> names(K);
        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            cin >> names[i];
            standardize_set.insert(names[i]);
        }
    }

    unordered_map<string, int> name_to_index;
    for (int i = 0; i < C; ++i) {
        name_to_index[columns[i]] = i;
    }

    vector<vector<double>> std_values;

    for (const string& col : standardize_set) {
        int idx = name_to_index[col];
        vector<double> row_std(R);

        double sum_x = 0.0;
        for (int row = 0; row < R; ++row) {
            sum_x += stod(data[row][idx]);
        }
        double mean = sum_x / R;

        double sum_sq_diff = 0.0;
        for (int row = 0; row < R; ++row) {
            double diff = stod(data[row][idx]) - mean;
            sum_sq_diff += diff * diff;
        }
        double variance = sum_sq_diff / R;
        double std_dev = sqrt(variance);

        if (variance < 1e-9) std_dev = 0.0;

        for (int row = 0; row < R; ++row) {
            double x = stod(data[row][idx]);
            double val = (x - mean) / std_dev;
            row_std[row] = val;
        }

        std_values.push_back(row_std);
    }

    for (const string& col : columns) {
        cout << col << " ";
    }
    cout << endl;

    for (int row = 0; row < R; ++row) {
        ostringstream oss;
        for (int col = 0; col < C; ++col) {
            bool std_col = standardize_set.count(columns[col]);
            if (std_col) {
                int idx = name_to_index[columns[col]];
                oss << fixed << setprecision(6) << std_values[idx][row];
            } else {
                oss << data[row][col];
            }
            oss << " ";
        }
        cout << oss.str() << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

import re

def process_string(s, acronym_map):
    processed = []
    i = 0
    n = len(s)
    while i < n:
        if s[i].isupper():
            # Start of possible acronym
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j].isupper():
                j += 1
            acronym = s[i:j]
            # Check if acronym is valid (bounded by non-letters or start/end)
            valid = True
            # Check start
            if i > 0 and s[i-1].isalpha():
                valid = False
            # Check end
            if j < n and s[j].isalpha():

            # Also, check if acronym is in the map
            if valid and acronym in acronym_map:
                expanded = acronym_map[acronym]
                processed.append(expanded)
                i = j
            else:
                processed.append(acronym)
                i = j
        else:
            processed.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    return ''.join(processed)

    if isinstance(value, str):

    elif isinstance(value, (int, float)) or value is None:

    else:
        # According to problem statement, cells are string, number, or null

#include <iostream>

```cpp
int main() {
    int R, C;
    cin >> R >> C;

    vector<vector<double>> matrix(R, vector<double>(C));

    for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < C; ++j) {
            cin >> matrix[i][j];
        }
    }

    for (auto& row : matrix) {
        for (double& val : row) {
            if (val < 0.5) val = 0.0;
        }
    }

    for (int j = 0; j < C; ++j) {
        vector<double> col;
        for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) col.push_back(matrix[i][j]);
        double sum = accumulate(col.begin(), col.end(), 0.0);
        double mean = sum / R;
        double var = 0.0;
        for (double x : col) var += (x - mean) * (x - mean);
        var /= R;
        double std_dev = sqrt(var);

        if (std_dev == 0) {
            fill(matrix[0].begin() + j, matrix[0].begin() + j + R, 0.0);
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < R; ++i) {
                matrix[i][j] = (matrix[i][j] - mean) / std_dev;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << fixed << setprecision(6);
    for (const auto& row : matrix) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < row.size(); ++j) {
            if (j > 0) cout << " ";
            cout << round(row[j] * 1e6) / 1e6;
        }
        cout << endl;
    }

    return 0;
}
```

            in_token = True
        elif in_token:

                current_token.append(c)

```python
                    word_part = []
                    i = 0
                    while i < len(token) and token[i] == '$':
                        dollar_part.append(token[i])
                        i += 1
                    word_part = token[i:]
                    if not word_part:
                        tokens.append(None)

                    if len(dollar_part) == 1:
                        key = ''.join(word_part)
```

```python
}

def main():
    text = sys.stdin.read()
    # Find all word-like sequences (letters, digits, underscores)
    tokens = re.findall(r'\w+', text)
    
    ordered_words = []
    counts = {}
```

```cpp
using namespace std;

vector<string> split_csv(const string& s) {
    vector<string> res;
    size_t pos = 0;
    size_t next;
    while ((next = s.find(',', pos)) != string::npos) {
        res.push_back(s.substr(pos, next - pos));
        pos = next + 1;
    }
    res.push_back(s.substr(pos));
    return res;
}

string trim(const string& s) {
    size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(" \t");
    if (start == string::npos) return "";
    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t");
    return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
}

enum class ValueType { INT, FLOAT, STRING, NULL_VAL };

ValueType parse_value_type(const string& s) {
    if (s.empty()) return ValueType::NULL_VAL;
    string trimmed = trim(s);
    if (trimmed.empty()) return ValueType::NULL_VAL;

    // Check for integer
    size_t sign_start = 0;
    if (!trimmed.empty() && (trimmed[0] == '+' || trimmed[0] == '-')) {
        sign_start = 1;
    }
    string num_part = trimmed.substr(sign_start);
    if (num_part.empty()) return ValueType::INT;
    bool all_digits = all_of(num_part.begin(), num_part.end(), ::isdigit);
    if (all_digits) return ValueType::INT;

    // Check for float or exponent
    size_t decimal = trimmed.find('.');
    if (decimal != string::npos) {
        size_t exp_pos = trimmed.find('e', decimal + 1);
        if (exp_pos != string::npos) return ValueType::FLOAT;
        else return ValueType::FLOAT;
    }

    size_t exp_pos = trimmed.find('e');
    if (exp_pos != string::npos) return ValueType::FLOAT;

    return ValueType::STRING;
}

    string header_line;

            return 0;

            // Invalid if data rows exist with zero headers

            for (const auto& h : headers) {

        for (size_t i = 0; i < row.size(); ++i) {

            switch (type) {
                case ValueType::INT:
                    json_val = to_string(stoi(value));

                case ValueType::FLOAT:
                    json_val = to_string(stod(value));
                    break;
                case ValueType::STRING:
                    json_val = "\"" + value + "\"";
                    break;
                case ValueType::NULL_VAL:
                    json_val = "null";
                    break;
            }
            row_data.emplace_back(headers[i], json_val);
        }
        json_rows.push_back(row_data);

    if (json_rows.empty()) {
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>
#include <algorithm>
#include <memory>
#include <stdexcept>

using namespace std;

enum class ValueType { Null, Int, Float, String };

struct ParsedValue {
    ValueType type;
    union {
        int integer;
        double double_val;
        string string_val;
    };
    bool is_null = false;
};

vector<string> split(const string& s, char delimiter) {
    vector<string> tokens;
    string token;
    istringstream tokenStream(s);
    while (getline(tokenStream, token, delimiter)) {
        tokens.push_back(token);
    }
    return tokens;
}

 ParsedValue parse_value(const string& value) {
    string stripped;
    size_t start = 0;
    size_t end = value.find_first_not_of(" \t");
    if (end == string::npos) {
        stripped = "";
    } else {
        stripped = value.substr(start, end - start);
        start = end + 1;
        end = value.find_first_not_of(" \t", start);
        if (end == string::npos) {
            stripped += "";
        } else {
            stripped += value.substr(start, end - start);
        }
    }

    if (stripped.empty()) {
        return {ValueType::Null, {}};
    }

    ParsedValue res;
    res.is_null = false;

    try {
        size_t pos;
        int num = stoi(stripped, &pos);
        if (pos == stripped.size()) {
            res.type = ValueType::Int;
            res.integer = num;
            return res;
        }
        double d = stod(stripped, &pos);
        if (pos == stripped.size()) {
            res.type = ValueType::Float;
            res.double_val = d;
            return res;
        }
    } catch (...) {
    }

    res.type = ValueType::String;
    res.string_val = stripped;
    return res;
}

bool has_newline(const string& s) {
    return s.find('\n') != string::npos;
}

int main() {
    string header_line;
    getline(cin, header_line);
    vector<string> headers = split(header_line, ',');
    vector<vector<ParsedValue>> rows;

    string row;
    while (getline(cin, row)) {
        if (has_newline(row)) row = row.substr(0, row.find('\n'));
        vector<string> row_parts = split(row, ',');
        if (row_parts.size() != headers.size()) continue;

        vector<ParsedValue> parsed_row;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < row_parts.size(); ++i) {
            ParsedValue val = parse_value(row_parts[i]);
            parsed_row.push_back(val);
        }

        rows.push_back(parsed_row);
    }

    if (rows.empty() && headers.empty()) {
        cout << "[]" << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    cout << "[";
    bool first = true;
    for (const auto& row : rows) {
        if (!first) cout << ",";
        first = false;

        cout << "{" ;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < headers.size(); ++i) {
            const auto& header = headers[i];
            const auto& val = row[i];

            if (val.is_null) {
                cout << "null,";
            } else if (val.type == ValueType::Int) {
                cout << header << ":" << val.integer << ",";
            } else if (val.type == ValueType::Float) {
                cout << header << ":" << val.double_val << ",";
            } else {
                cout << header << ":\"" << val.string_val << "\",";
            }
        }
        cout << "}";
    }
    cout << "]" << endl;

    return 0;
}
```

import sys

    lines = [line.strip() for line in sys.stdin.read().splitlines()]

```python
        print("ERROR: NO INPUT")
        return
    
    target_name = lines[0]
    remaining_lines = lines[1:]

    blocks = []

    for line in remaining_lines:

            if current_block:

                current_block = []
            continue
        current_block.append(stripped)
    if current_block:
        blocks.append(current_block)

    for block in blocks:
        if not block:
            continue
        first_line = block[0]
        if first_line.startswith('GROUP '):
            group_name = first_line.split()[1]
            headers = block[1].split(',') if len(block) > 1 else []
            data = []
            for line in block[2:]:
                data.append(line.split(','))
            if not headers or not data:
                continue
            groups.append({
                'name': group_name,
                'headers': headers,
                'data': data
            })
    
    target_group = None
    for group in groups:
        if group['name'] == target_name:
            target_group = group
            break
    
    if not target_group:
        print("ERROR: GROUP NOT FOUND")

            sums[h] += val

    for h in headers:
        total = sums[h]
        if total.is_integer():
            sum_pairs.append(f"{h}={int(total)}")
        else:
```

```cpp
using namespace std;

vector<string> parse_csv(const string& csv) {
    vector<string> fields;
    if (csv.empty()) return fields;

    string current_field;
    bool in_quotes = false;
    bool escape_next = false;

    for (char c : csv) {
        if (in_quotes) {
            if (c == '"' && !escape_next) {
                in_quotes = false;
            } else if (c == '"' && escape_next) {
                current_field += '"';
                escape_next = false;
            } else {
                current_field += c;
            }
            if (c == ',' || c == '\n') {
                fields.push_back(current_field);
                current_field.clear();
                if (c == '\n') break; // Handle end of line
            }
        } else {
            if (c == '"' && !escape_next) {
                in_quotes = true;
                escape_next = true;
            } else if (c == '"' && escape_next) {
                current_field += '"';
                escape_next = false;
            } else {

            }
            if (c == ',' || c == '\n') {
                fields.push_back(current_field);
                current_field.clear();
                if (c == '\n') break;
            }
        }
    }
    if (!current_field.empty()) fields.push_back(current_field);

    return fields;
}
```

```cpp
vector<string> parse_csv_line(const string& line) {
    vector<string> fields;
    string current_field;
    bool in_quotes = false;

    for (char c : line) {
        if (in_quotes) {
            if (c == '"') {
                in_quotes = false;
                current_field += "\"\"";
            } else {
                current_field += c;

                if (!current_field.empty()) {
                    fields.push_back(current_field);
                    current_field.clear();
                }
            } else {
                current_field += c;
            }
        }
    }

    if (!current_field.empty()) {
        fields.push_back(current_field);
    }

    return fields;
}

}
```

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

struct KeyValue {
    string key;
    string value;
};

vector<vector<KeyValue>> parse_json_array(const string& json) {
    // parse the JSON array into a list of objects (each object is a vector of KeyValue)
    // this is a simplified parser
    vector<vector<KeyValue>> result;

    // trim function
    auto trim = [](const string& s) -> string {
        size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        if (start == string::npos) return "";
        size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t");
        return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
    };

    if (json.empty() || json[0] != '[' || json.back() != ']') {
        return {};
    }

    string content = json.substr(1, json.size() - 2);
    size_t start_pos = 0;
    size_t end_pos = content.find(',', start_pos);

    while (end_pos != string::npos) {
        string obj = content.substr(start_pos, end_pos - start_pos);
        obj = trim(obj);
        if (obj.empty()) {
            start_pos = end_pos + 1;
            continue;
        }

        // parse object
        vector<KeyValue> obj_kv;
        size_t brace_open = obj.find_first_of("{");
        size_t brace_close = obj.find_last_of("}");
        if (brace_open == string::npos || brace_close == string::npos || brace_open >= brace_close) {
            start_pos = end_pos + 1;
            continue;
        }
        obj = obj.substr(brace_open, brace_close - brace_open + 1);
        obj = trim(obj);

        // parse key-value pairs
        size_t colon_pos = obj.find(':');
        while (colon_pos != string::npos) {
            size_t key_end = colon_pos;
            size_t next_colon = obj.find(':', key_end + 1);
            if (next_colon == string::npos) {
                key_end = obj.size();
            }
            string key = obj.substr(0, key_end);
            key = trim(key);

            size_t comma_pos = obj.find(',', colon_pos + 1);
            size_t val_end = comma_pos == string::npos ? obj.size() : comma_pos;
            string value_part = obj.substr(colon_pos + 1, val_end - colon_pos - 1);
            value_part = trim(value_part);

            // parse value (simplified)
            if (value_part == "null") {
                obj_kv.push_back({key, "null"});
            } else if (value_part == "true" || value_part == "false") {
                obj_kv.push_back({key, value_part});
            } else if (all_of(value_part.begin(), value_part.end(), ::isdigit)) {
                obj_kv.push_back({key, to_string(stoi(value_part))});
            } else if (!value_part.empty() && value_part[0] == '"' && value_part.back() == '"') {
                obj_kv.push_back({key, "\"" + value_part.substr(1, value_part.size()-2) + "\""});
            } else {
                obj_kv.push_back({key, "\"" + value_part + "\""});
            }

            colon_pos = next_colon;
        }

        result.push_back(obj_kv);
        start_pos = end_pos + 1;
        end_pos = content.find(',', start_pos);
    }

    return result;
}

string generate_json(const vector<vector<KeyValue>>& array) {
    stringstream ss;
    ss << "[";
    for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); ++i) {
        if (i > 0) ss << ",";
        for (size_t j = 0; j < array[i].size(); ++j) {
            if (j > 0) ss << ",";
            ss << "{\"";
            ss << array[i][j].key << "\":";
            if (array[i][j].value == "null") {
                ss << "null";
            } else if (array[i][j].value == "true" || array[i][j].value == "false") {
                ss << (array[i][j].value == "true" ? "true" : "false");
            } else if (array[i][j].value.find_first_not_of("0123456789") == string::npos) {
                ss << stoi(array[i][j].value);
            } else {
                ss << "\"" << array[i][j].value << "\"";
            }
            ss << "}";
        }
        ss << "}";
    }
    ss << "]";
    return ss.str();
}

    getline(cin, remove_key);
    string json_input;
    string line;
    while (getline(cin, line)) {
        json_input += line + "\n";
    }

    vector<vector<KeyValue>> array = parse_json_array(json_input);

    vector<vector<KeyValue>> filtered_array;
    for (auto& obj : array) {
        vector<KeyValue> filtered;
        for (auto& kv : obj) {
            if (kv.key != remove_key) {
                filtered.push_back(kv);
            }
        }
        filtered_array.push_back(filtered);
    }

    string output = generate_json(filtered_array);
    cout << output << endl;

    return 0;
}

To solve this problem, we need to read a JSON value from standard input, which represents a nested list of numbers. Our goal is to compute the median of all the leaf numbers found at any depth within this nested structure. The median should be rounded to exactly four decimal places, or "None" if no numbers are present.

### Approach
1. **Parse the JSON Input**: Use a JSON parsing library to convert the input string into a structured format.
2. **Collect Leaf Numbers**: Traverse the parsed JSON structure recursively to collect all numerical values into a flat list.
3. **Compute the Median**: 
   - Sort the collected numbers.
   - Calculate the median based on whether the count of numbers is odd or even.
4. **Format the Result**: Ensure the median is rounded to four decimal places or output "None" if no numbers are found.

### Solution Code
```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>
#include <cstdio>

#include "rapidjson/document.h"
#include "rapidjson/writer.h"
#include "rapidjson/stringbuffer.h"

using namespace rapidjson;

bool isNumber(const JSONValue& value) {
    return value.IsNumber();
}

void collectNumbers(const JSONValue& value, std::vector<double>& nums) {
    if (value.IsArray()) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < value.Size(); ++i) {
            collectNumbers(value[i], nums);
        }
    } else if (isNumber(value)) {
        nums.push_back(value.GetDouble());
    }
}

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);

    StringBuffer buffer;
    Writer writer(buffer);
    writer.Parse(input.c_str());

    Doc document = writer.GetResult();

    std::vector<double> nums;
    collectNumbers(document, nums);

    if (nums.empty()) {
        std::cout << "None\n";
        return 0;
    }

    std::sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());

    size_t n = nums.size();
    double median;

    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        double a = nums[(n/2)-1];
        double b = nums[n/2];
        median = (a + b) / 2.0;
    } else {
        median = nums[n/2];
    }

    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4) << median << ".0000\n";

    return 0;
}
```

4. **Output**: The median is formatted to four decimal places using `std::fixed` and `std::setprecision(4)`. If no numbers are found, "None" is printed.

import sys
import re

```python
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    input_text = sys.stdin.read()
    
    # Remove all substrings enclosed in square brackets
    cleaned_text = re.sub(r'\[.*?\]', '', input_text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    
    # Extract word characters, filter those with length >=2 and lowercase
    words = re.findall(r'\w+', cleaned_text)
    valid_words = [word.lower() for word in words if len(word) >= 2]
    
    if not valid_words:

    word_counts = defaultdict(int)
    for word in valid_words:

    # Calculate sum of squares of counts
    sum_squares = sum(count ** 2 for count in word_counts.values())
    
    # Compute scores
    result = []
    for word in sorted(word_counts.keys()):
        score = word_counts[word] / math.sqrt(sum_squares)
        rounded_score = round(score, 4)
        result.append(f"{word}: {rounded_score}")
```

    try {
        size_t pos;
        double d = stod(s, &pos);

}

        res += delim + v[i];
    return res;
}

            }
        }

```cpp
#include <iostream>
```

```cpp
using namespace std;

vector<string> split(const string& s, char delim) {
    vector<string> res;
    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < s.size()) {
        size_t next = s.find(delim, pos + 1);
        if (next == string::npos) {
            res.push_back(s.substr(pos));
            break;
        } else {
            res.push_back(s.substr(pos, next - pos));
            pos = next + 1;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

string trim(const string& s) {
    size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(" \t");
    if (start == string::npos) return "";
    size_t end = s.find_last_not_of(" \t");
    return s.substr(start, end - start + 1);
}

string format_mean(double value) {
    ostringstream oss;
    oss << fixed << setprecision(6) << value;
    string s = oss.str();
    
    size_t decimal_pos = s.find('.');
    if (decimal_pos == string::npos) {
        return s;
    }
    
    size_t last_non_zero = s.rfind('1', decimal_pos);
    if (last_non_zero != decimal_pos) {
        s = s.substr(0, last_non_zero + 1);
    } else {
        s = s.substr(0, decimal_pos);
    }
    
    size_t last_non_zero_trailing = s.rfind('1');
    if (last_non_zero_trailing == string::npos) {
        if (!s.empty() && s.back() == '.') {
            s.pop_back();
        }
    }
    
    return s;
}

        }

}
```

    vector<double> data;

```cpp
    double num;
    while (iss1 >> num) {
        data.push_back(num);
    }

    double threshold = 2.0;
    if (getline(cin, line2)) {
        istringstream iss2(line2);
        if (iss2 >> threshold) {
            char c;
            while (iss2.get(c)) {
                if (!iss2.fail()) iss2.ignore(1, '\n');
            }
        }
    }

    int n = data.size();
    if (n == 0) {
        cout << "0.0000\n0.0000\n";
        return 0;
    }

    double sum_data = accumulate(data.begin(), data.end(), 0.0);
    double mean = sum_data / n;

    double sum_sq_diff = 0.0;
    for (double x : data) sum_sq_diff += (x - mean) * (x - mean);
    double variance = sum_sq_diff / n;
    double std_dev = sqrt(variance);

    vector<int> outliers;
    if (std_dev > 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            double z = (data[i] - mean) / std_dev;
            if (fabs(z) > threshold) outliers.push_back(i);
        }
    }

    cout << fixed << setprecision(4);
    if (!outliers.empty()) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < outliers.size(); ++i) {
            if (i > 0) cout << ' ';
            cout << outliers[i];
        }
        cout << endl;
    } else cout << endl;

    cout << mean << '\n' << variance << endl;
    return 0;
```

```python
import sys
```

def format_number(n):
    rounded = round(n, 6)
    s = "{0:.6f}".format(rounded)
    parts = s.split('.')
    if len(parts) == 1:
        return f"{parts[0].rstrip('0')}.0"
    else:
        integer_part, decimal_part = parts
        decimal_part = decimal_part.rstrip('0')
        if not decimal_part:
            return f"{integer_part}.0"
        else:
            return f"{integer_part}.{decimal_part}"

        tokens.push_back(token);
    }
    return tokens;

```cpp
    }
    cout << " " << fixed << setprecision(2) << overall_avg << endl;

}
```

```cpp
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

string trim(const string &s) {
    size_t first = s.find_first_not_of(" \t\n\r");
    if (first == string::npos) return "";
    size_t last = s.find_last_not_of(" \t\n\r");
    return s.substr(first, last - first + 1);
}

vector<string> split(const string &s) {
    vector<string> tokens;
    stringstream ss(s);
    string token;
    while (ss >> token) {
        tokens.push_back(token);
    }
    return tokens;
}

vector<double> parse_tokens(const vector<string> &tokens) {
    vector<double> A;
    for (const string &s : tokens) {
        size_t pos;
        try {
            double x = stod(s, &pos);
            if (pos != s.size()) return {};
            A.push_back(x);
        } catch (...) {
            return {};
        }
    }
    return A;
}

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    string trimmed = trim(line);
    if (trimmed == "MISSING") {
        cout << "KeyError" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<string> tokens = split(trimmed);
    vector<double> A = parse_tokens(tokens);
    if (A.empty()) {
        cout << "TypeError" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    double min_val = A[0], max_val = A[0];
    for (double x : A) {
        if (x < min_val) min_val = x;
        if (x > max_val) max_val = x;
    }
    if (min_val == max_val) {
        for (double x : A) cout << "0.0000 ";
        cout << endl;
    } else {
        for (double x : A) {
            double scaled = (x - min_val) / (max_val - min_val);
            cout << fixed << setprecision(4) << scaled << " ";
        }
        cout << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
```

```python
import math

word = input().strip()
n = len(word)
differences = []

if n >= 2:
    for i in range(n - 1):
        d = ord(word[i+1]) - ord(word[i])
        differences.append(d)

if not differences:
    print()
    print("0.0000000000")
else:
    S = sum(differences)
    if S == 0:
        all_zero = all(d == 0 for d in differences)
        entropy = 0.0 if all_zero else -float('inf')
    else:
        if S > 0:
            has_neg = any(d < 0 for d in differences)
        else:
            has_pos = any(d > 0 for d in differences)
        if has_neg or has_pos:
            entropy = -float('inf')
        else:
            sum_t = 0.0
            for d in differences:
                p = d / S
                if p > 0:
                    sum_t += (-p * math.log(p))
            entropy = sum_t

    if differences:
        print(' '.join(map(str, differences)))
    else:
        print()

    if entropy == float('inf'):
        print("inf")
    elif entropy == -float('inf'):
        print("-inf")
    else:
```
